decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical server-call parameter layout.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
Selected DOS srvcall.asm includes dpl.asm and uses the register, user and process ID fields.
Prior SRVCALL comparison covered 342 bytes; all 15 differing bytes were in marked address fields, with remaining aligned bytes matching (review 108).
limitations: The selected-module comparison supports fields exercised there; it does not prove every possible structure use, final addresses or complete kernel identity.
